title: TRAC ACTUATOR REMOVAL
ocr_text:
BR–121
BRAKE SYSTEM – TRACTION CONTROL SYSTEM (TRAC)

TRAC ACTUATOR REMOVAL

Installation is in the reverse order of removal.
AFTER INSTALLATION, BLEED BRAKE SYSTEM (See page BR–7) AND BLEED TRAC SYSTEM (See page BR–9)

1. DISCONNECT BRAKE LINES
Using SST, disconnect the brake lines from the TRAC actuator.
SST 09751–36011
Torque: 15 N·m (155 kgf·cm, 11 ft·lbf)

2. REMOVE TRAC ACTUATOR ASSEMBLY
Remove the 2 bolts, nut and TRAC actuator assembly.
Torque: 13 N·m (130 kgf·cm, 9 ft·lbf)

3. REMOVE TRAC ACTUATOR
Remove the 3 bolts and actuator from the bracket.
Torque: 13 N·m (130 kgf·cm, 9 ft·lbf)

4. SEPARATE TRAC ACTUATOR BRACKET
Remove the 2 bolts and separate the bracket.
Torque: 13 N·m (130 kgf·cm, 9 ft·lbf)

SST
R07270
